_note: Alumni: 'now' is the most recent position we know of; older entries date from the 2022 site. Update 'now' when you hear news.

current.name: Charles Gawad, MD, PhD
current.bio: Chuck is an Associate Professor of Pediatrics at Stanford Medicine and a practicing pediatric oncologist. He invented primary template-directed amplification (PTA) and co-founded BioSkryb Genomics. Outside of work he enjoys anything outdoors in the Bay Area and spending time with his family.

current.name: Veronica Gonzalez-Pena, PhD
current.bio: Veronica received her PhD in Pharmacology and Toxicology from the University of Arizona. In the lab she is passionate about working out the details of new biotechnology methods. In her free time she enjoys gardening and spending time with her family.

alumni.name: Athena Aragon
alumni.bio: Athena joined the lab in 2021 after earning her bachelor's in Human Biology at UC Santa Cruz and worked on single-cell sequencing of pediatric leukemia and neural tissue.

alumni.name: Yakun Pang, PhD
alumni.bio: Yakun received her PhD in Internal Medicine (Hematology) from Peking Union Medical College. In the lab she studied pediatric acute leukemia with single-cell genomic and transcriptomic sequencing and led the longitudinal clonal evolution study of pediatric ALL.

alumni.name: Kartika Wardhani, PhD
alumni.bio: Kartika received her PhD in Chemistry from the University of Sydney and worked on new single-cell chemistry in the lab.

alumni.name: David Klein
alumni.bio: David received a BA in Biology from NYU and an MS in Biomedical Sciences from Tufts, then worked on computational analysis of single-cell and cell-free sequencing data before medical school at the California University of Science and Medicine.
alumni.now: Internal medicine resident, Santa Clara Valley Medical Center

alumni.name: Brandon Cai
alumni.bio: Brandon studied Molecular and Cell Biology and Public Health at UC Berkeley and worked on single-cell data analysis in the lab.

alumni.name: Shawn Schulz
alumni.bio: Shawn majored in Molecular and Cell Biology at UC Berkeley and applied data science to the lab's -omic data.
alumni.now: MS student in Computational Biology, UC Berkeley

alumni.name: Syahmi Ali Mohd Rizal
alumni.bio: Stanford undergraduate in engineering who worked on emerging medical technologies in the lab.

alumni.name: Vibhu Agarwal, PhD
alumni.bio: Vibhu received his PhD in Biostatistics from Stanford and developed the e-nose AI analytics in the lab.
alumni.now: Senior Director of Data Science, Medidata Solutions

alumni.name: Yuntao Xia, PhD
alumni.bio: Yuntao received his PhD in Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering from UPenn and developed single-cell and cell-free sequencing protocols and computational pipelines in the lab.
alumni.now: Principal Scientist and Clinical Lab Supervisor, Orchid Health

alumni.name: Sivaraman Natarajan, PhD
alumni.bio: Siva received his PhD in Neuroscience from Universität des Saarlandes and helped develop several new single-cell and cell-free DNA sequencing protocols.
alumni.now: Staff Scientist, St. Jude Children's Research Hospital

alumni.name: Rob Carter, PhD
alumni.bio: Rob received his PhD in Biology from the University of Ottawa and led the development of the lab's computational pipelines.
alumni.now: Bioinformatics consultant; previously Director of Bioinformatics, BioSkryb Genomics

alumni.name: Anju Cherian
alumni.bio: Anju received her MS in Biomedical Research from the Morehouse School of Medicine and worked on single-cell sequencing methods, staying on at St. Jude when the lab moved to Stanford.
alumni.now: Researcher, St. Jude Children's Research Hospital

alumni.name: Ousman Mahmud, PhD
alumni.bio: Ousman received his PhD in Genetics from the University of Georgia and built computational pipelines for cell-free and single-cell sequencing.
alumni.now: Application Scientist, Linguamatics (IQVIA); previously IBM Watson Health

alumni.name: Yuki Inaba
alumni.bio: Yuki received a BS from Brown and worked on cell-free DNA sequencing in the lab for a year.

alumni.name: Morgan Carter
alumni.bio: Morgan developed methods for single-cell mitochondrial sequencing as an undergraduate at the University of Virginia.
alumni.now: NCI Cancer Research Training Award fellow, NIH

alumni.name: Ian Nykaza
alumni.bio: Ian learned single-cell sequencing as an undergraduate at the University of Minnesota and worked as a clinical coordinator at UCSF before medical school.
alumni.now: Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, after his MD at Weill Cornell

alumni.name: Sarah Youssef
alumni.bio: Sarah completed her MS in Pharmacology as a Fulbright Scholar while studying cell-free DNA sequencing in the lab.
alumni.now: Board-certified oncology pharmacist, Children's Cancer Hospital Egypt 57357

alumni.name: Greg Schwing
alumni.bio: Greg studied barcoding and single-cell sequencing of leukemia samples as an undergraduate at the University of New Orleans.

alumni.name: Shelby Lane
alumni.bio: Shelby studied single-cell sequencing of leukemia samples as a medical student researcher.
alumni.now: Medical student, University of Tennessee Health Science Center
